title: Mesh versus math
sub: B-rep, NURBS and a true circle
cards/0/body:
In a mesh, a cylinder might be 64 triangles: it looks right, but it is an approximation.

In CAD, a cylinder is “a cylindrical surface with a 50 mm radius”: exact math. You can approximate it down to a micron, compute its volume exactly, or drill a hole dead center.
cards/1/title: B-rep: a boundary made of exact pieces
cards/1/body:
CAD describes a solid by its boundary: B-rep (boundary representation). Faces are pieces of exact surfaces: plane, cylinder, torus, NURBS. Edges are exact curves. Vertices are points.

On top of that there is topology: which face borders which, and along which edge.
cards/2/q: How many faces does a cylinder have in B-rep?
cards/2/options/0: 3: two flat caps and one cylindrical face
cards/2/explain: The side is one face lying on an exact cylindrical surface, plus two flat ones.
cards/2/deep: Many geometry kernels (Parasolid, ACIS, Open CASCADE) cut the side face with a “seam”: a helper edge where the surface closes on itself. There are still three faces.
cards/3/title: NURBS: how to write any curve
cards/3/body:
NURBS (non-uniform rational B-splines) are curves and surfaces defined by control points with weights.

A plain Bézier curve cannot draw an exact circle, only something close. Give a control point a weight, and it can.
cards/4/task: An arc from three control points. Tune the middle point’s weight so the curve lies on the circle: error under 0.05 mm at a 50 mm radius.
cards/5/q: Which weight gave an exact quarter circle?
cards/5/explain: For an arc spanning angle θ, the middle weight is cos(θ/2). For 90° that is cos 45° ≈ 0.7071.
cards/6/options/0: A parabola: a plain Bézier curve that only approximates the circle
cards/6/explain: Without weights a quadratic Bézier curve is a piece of a parabola. The demo shows the error: about 3 mm at a 50 mm radius.
cards/7/q: What can you do exactly with CAD geometry but not with a mesh? Select all.
cards/7/options/1: Get the exact radius of a hole
cards/7/options/2: Build an exact fillet along an edge
cards/7/options/3: Show it in a browser right away with no preparation
cards/7/explain: For display, though, CAD actually has to be turned into triangles. That is the next lesson.
cards/8/pairs/0/1: A solid as a set of exact faces
cards/8/pairs/1/1: Curves with control points and weights
